declaration.background: Schwarzschild exterior, M=1, ingoing Eddington-Finkelstein convention exp(+I*omega*v)
declaration.frequency_profiles: C_c^infinity((1/2,3/4)); negative frequencies fixed by the real-field involution
declaration.theory: strict linearized four-dimensional pure Weyl C^2 gravity

disposition.missing_dependency: Two additional exact infinity recurrence orders and a p>=5 omega-differentiated Volterra envelope.
disposition.what_is_proved: Exact all-order scalar IBP lemma, its six-head formal application, uniform exact coefficient bounds through three omega derivatives, and the first missing remainder derivative with minimum recurrence depth.

does_not_establish: a bounded exact-solution trace at Iplus or Iminus
a finite Lee-Wald wave-packet flux Gram, radical, quotient or inertia
pole exclusion, stability, CPT positivity, particles or unitarity

endpoint_flux_disposition.orientation: Iplus and Iminus retain separate outward-normal conventions; they are never combined into one local endpoint test.
endpoint_flux_disposition.reason: The exact three-derivative remainder estimate needed to pass from formal heads to a bounded wave-packet trace is absent; a formal fixed-frequency Gram is not promoted as a physical null-flux Gram.

exact_remainder_derivative_audit.first_failure: At k=2 and p=3 the absolute Volterra majorant is r^(-1) times logarithms and is not integrable.
exact_remainder_derivative_audit.phase_derivative_rule: Each omega derivative of exp(+/-2*I*omega*r)*r^(+/-4*I*omega) costs at most one power of r (log r is subleading).
exact_remainder_derivative_audit.required_extension: Extend H0 and H1 from inverse order 3 through inverse order 5, retain the derivative-forced F coefficient through inverse order 6, and reprove a cross-rate p>=5 Volterra envelope with omega derivatives k=0,1,2,3.

formal_joint_symbol_bounds.method: exact rational l1 coefficient bound using omega<=3/4 and omega^(-1)<=2
formal_joint_symbol_bounds.pole_statement: Every displayed coefficient and its first three omega derivatives is uniformly bounded; the only real denominator zero is omega=0, outside the profile support.

matching_direction_formal_trace.limit_integral_interchange_for_heads: The finite formal heads obey uniform coefficient bounds on compact frequency support, so dominated convergence applies after the declared columnwise radiation rescaling.

scalar_nonstationary_phase_lemma.formal_head_consequence: Every displayed wrong-endpoint finite head vanishes after three integrations by parts, including the r^2 metric heads.
scalar_nonstationary_phase_lemma.proof: Integrate by parts N times. Every boundary term vanishes because b has compact support in the open interval.
scalar_nonstationary_phase_lemma.statement: If b is C_c^N((1/2,3/4)) and Phi has constant nonzero omega derivative L, then |integral exp(I*omega*L)b(omega)domega| <= |L|^(-N)*||d_omega^N b||_L1.

wrong_endpoint_phases.nonstationarity: For fixed u or v, |L| is bounded below by r for all sufficiently large r.
